auth_methods.quote: The MrScraper API uses API token authentication to secure all endpoints. Every request must include a valid API token in the HTTP request headers.

access.quote: Free costs nothing - no credit card required. It's the fastest way to try scraping, proxies and AI extraction before upgrading.

api_surface.breadth.quote: Comprehensive documentation for MrScraper's API endpoints, including authentication, pagination, error handling, and scraper management.

mcp.exists.quote: Official MrScraper MCP server for retrieving web pages, web search, and account usage.

buildability.main_blocker.quote: Sign in to the dashboard, open your account settings, and copy the token from the API Token page.

buildability.verdict.quote: API tokens are managed directly from your MrScraper dashboard.
